In [[topology]], a branch of [[mathematics]], for <math>i \ge 2</math>, the '''''i''-th homotopy group with coefficients''' in an [[abelian group]] ''G'' of a [[pointed space|based space]] ''X'' is the [[pointed set]] of [[homotopy]] classes of based maps from the [[Moore space (algebraic topology)|Moore space]] of type <math>(G, i)</math> to ''X'', and is denoted by <math>\pi_i(X; G)</math>.<ref>{{harvnb|Weibel|2013|loc=Ch. IV. Definition 2.1}}</ref> For <math>i \ge 3</math>, <math>\pi_i(X; G)</math> is a [[group (mathematics)|group]]. The groups <math>\pi_i(X; \Z)</math> are the usual [[homotopy group]]s of ''X''.
